correctness.rationale: For each divisor p^j the p-adic valuation is computed exactly. Legendre’s formula shows all terms exceed 3r-2 except the terminal j=r term, with one explicit tie case p=3,r=2. value.rationale: The result sharpens a named classical congruence on a natural infinite stratum. It identifies the exact p-adic order uniformly for every odd prime power, improving the exponent from 2r to 3r-2 for r>2 and proving optimality even when r=2. The proof also isolates the unique cancellation-sensitive exception in the termwise valuation argument.
